messages:
Sara Li: Hi everyone — quick heads-up: All-hands next Thursday 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET. Agenda draft: 1) Exec update + biz metrics (10m), 2) Product launch callouts (10m), 3) Security flags & policy change (Carlos, 5m), 4) Guest panel — SRE & DevEx on rollout best practices (15m), 5) Q&A (10m). Please drop any Qs below or add them to the form: https://forms.redwood/internal-allhands-qs. Calendar invite: https://cal.redwood.com/e/abc123. Will record and post transcript.
Mike Thompson: Will we have an APAC-friendly session or is this the one recording we'll use? I can forward to APAC team.
Sara Li: Recording + transcript will be the canonical artifact. We also plan to host a separate office-hours session next week for APAC — likely 1:30 PST/18:30 HKT, happy to coordinate with you, Mike.
Anya Kuznetsova: Can we add a 2-minute mention about Dedicated capacity pricing/commit window? Some customers asked for clarity. I can draft 1 slide.
Sara Li: Thanks Anya — please add that under product callouts. We'll keep slide deck to 15 min total so we don't run over.
Carlos (Security): Heads-up on the security segment: we'll announce a minor policy change around "security flags" — automated detection that surfaces potential PII/secret-intensive prompts for review. It's an opt-out for now but will default to on for Dedicated + Private by next quarter. I'll present the why, how it shows in Console, and a short mitigation checklist.
Jared: Quick question — does the flagging affect latency or token billing? Some infra folks worry about extra processing.
Carlos (Security): Good q. No change to per-token billing; flagging is async post-hoc analysis for now, not in-path inference. We'll publish an FAQ after the all-hands.
DevEx Bot: Reminder: add your question to the Qs form if you want it on the live Q&A: https://forms.redwood/internal-allhands-qs • Register if you haven't: https://events.redwood/allhands-2027
Mike Thompson: Also can we include captions? Recent hires need them.
Sara Li: Yes — captions enabled, and we'll attach the edited transcript + TL;DR bullets after the recording is up.
Anya Kuznetsova: I posted a short demo snippet (will share during the product slot) — depends on the Dedicated commit thresholds; I'll link to the PR in the follow-up thread.
Sara Li: Great. If folks want to nominate a question for the guest panel (SRE/DevEx), drop it here or on the form. We'll curate a few.
Carlos (Security): One note for presenters: please avoid showing internal customer names in slides. Use anonymized examples or test data.
Sara Li: Thanks Carlos — noted. Also: quick run-of-show for presenters — 2 slides each, max 3 min, send deck to @Sara Li by EOD Tuesday so we can assemble.
--later, after the meeting--
Sara Li: Recording is live: https://video.redwood/recs/2176543210. Transcript + captions: https://video.redwood/recs/2176543210/transcript. TL;DR takeaways: 1) Exec: steady growth in usage, focus on throughput and new regions, 2) Product: launch timeline for v2 routing + Dedicated commit windows clarified, 3) Security: security flags will be enabled by default for Dedicated/Private next quarter with opt-out; FAQ forthcoming, 4) Ops: SRE/DevEx shared best-practices for rollout and monitoring. Action items: - Anya to publish Dedicated commit slide + PR link (due Tue EOD), - Carlos to publish FAQ + mitigation checklist (due Fri), - DevEx to schedule APAC office hours (Mike leading).
Jared: Thanks for the clear notes — can we add the action items to Asana and assign owners? :thumbsup:
Sara Li: Yep — creating Asana task list now and will ping owners. Final note: if you have follow-ups for the guest panel, DM Carlos or Anya and we'll fold into the FAQ/update doc. Thanks all! :tada:
